562:t_1:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

562:t_1:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「...Are you sure about a space burial?」

562:t_1:6.en:
$n
「She said she loved both the $$翠の地球$$ and the $$蒼の地球$$. So she wanted a place where she could see them both...」

562:t_1:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's almost time to launch the capsule.」

562:t_1:11.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「She always seemed so happy... She brightened our lives...」

562:t_1:13.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We'll protect the two Earths you loved, no matter what...」

562:t_1:16.en:
$n
($$ティティ$$... When you told me that story, I never imagined things would turn out like this...)

562:t_1:17.en:
$n
(We fight because we don't want anyone else to suffer this sorrow...)

562:t_1:18.en:
$n
(And in the midst of that, you saved me. Thank you, $$ティティ$$...)

562:t_1:21.en:
$n
「I'm all right, $$宗介$$. You should stay with $$千鳥$$.」

562:t_1:22.en:
$n
「We've had to go into space so soon. Even she must be feeling anxious.」

562:t_1:25.en:
$n
「I know what you want to say. ...I'll get my head back in the game before the operation starts.」

562:t_1:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's good. But when you can't manage alone, rely on us.」

562:t_1:30.en:
$n
(Redoing the world... If we become obsessed with those words, we can't move forward...)

562:t_1:31.en:
$n
($$レナード・テスタロッサ$$... We stopped his ambition, but his words left invisible scars on our hearts...)

562:t_1:35.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Residential Area～

562:t_1:36.en:
$$ノノ$$
(...$$ティティ$$. $$ノノ$$ and the others will protect the Earth you loved, no matter what. Because...)

562:t_1:37.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...It seems they've finished repairing the damaged residential area for now.」

562:t_1:38.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It's thanks to $$カシオ$$ and the others working hard all night.」

562:t_1:39.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「How nice... Objects are easy to repair.」

562:t_1:40.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...Lost lives don't come back... You're sad about $$ティティ$$, too, $$ニコラ$$...」

562:t_1:43.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Honestly, what I feel is... envy, perhaps.」

562:t_1:44.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Because she won't have to see the despair that's coming.」

562:t_1:45.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It's all right, $$ニコラ$$! We'll stop the future of despair, no matter what! Because...!」

562:t_1:46.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$ノノ$$... You don't understand at all.」

562:t_1:48.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Just as I thought... You don't understand me at all.」

562:t_1:49.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「How I feel, about to reach 《$$あがり$$》 and lose my $$トップレス$$ powers!」

562:t_1:53.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You don't understand, do you!? The fear of losing $$トップレス$$ powers! How it feels to never be able to fly again!」

562:t_1:54.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's why! I'll use any means... even sell my soul to the devil, to stop it!」

562:t_1:55.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Did you want to join that man, $$レナード$$!?」

562:t_1:56.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I still have some pride left! I'd rather die than bow my head to someone like him!」

562:t_1:57.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So, $$ノノ$$! I'll take your power!」

562:t_1:59.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I want everything you have...! You're a $$バスターマシン$$ itself, aren't you!? Doesn't that make you a $$トップレス$$ forever!?」

562:t_1:60.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So! Give me everything you have!」

562:t_1:62.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Get away from $$ノノ$$, $$ニコラ$$!」

562:t_1:65.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Princess... And $$シンジ$$'s here, too...」

562:t_1:66.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The briefing... is starting soon... so I came... to get $$ノノ$$...」

562:t_1:68.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...Fine. Having you call more people would just make things troublesome.」

562:t_1:70.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You and $$タケル$$ wouldn't understand!」

562:t_1:71.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Someone like $$タケル$$, whose great power lasts forever, or $$シンジ$$, whose parent gave him an EVA, could never understand!」

562:t_1:72.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'm afraid of losing my power! It's the same as dying!」

562:t_1:75.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You got in my way! If I'd known it would come to this, I should've thrown away my pride and joined $$レナード$$!」

562:t_1:76.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Then the world would have been what I wanted!」

562:t_1:77.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...Is that all you have to say?」

562:t_1:79.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Whatever your reasons, I can't forgive you for hurting $$ノノ$$... and $$ラルク$$ and $$シンジ$$.」

562:t_1:83.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Why won't you... rely on me...?」

562:t_1:85.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You were always confident, so shrewd... Even knowing your kindness was a lie, I still liked you...!」
